detail: Condition D reports 42/42 (100%) abstentions while simultaneously reporting 2/30 (6.67%) fact-correct answers on answerable queries. Root cause: check_fact_correctness runs keyword search on draft_answer_text regardless of is_abstention flag, and aggregate_condition_metrics sums fact_correct answers without conditioning on not is_abstention.

GenerationAdapter._check_abstention() unconditionally assigns is_abstention=True when not request.evidence_passages, masking whether the underlying LLM actually followed the instruction to declare insufficient evidence or emitted hallucinations.

run_exp_2e_02.py line 915 only persists results_cond_a to per_query_results.json. Condition C and Condition D per-query evaluations were omitted from disk artifacts, limiting external recomputability of sub-metrics.

run_exp_2e_02.py omits cache saving after Condition D (saved after Condition A at L753 and Condition C at L783, but not after Condition D at L800). Consequently, Condition D LLM responses are missing from generation_cache.json.
